brief:
Avigdor Liberman declared that dismantling Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political coalition depends on securing the support of the ultra-Orthodox parties Shas and United Torah Judaism, Shehab Wire reported. Liberman framed an alliance with these factions as the only pathway to topple Netanyahu's government.

The far-right politician has proposed forming a new Israeli government led by Gadi Eisenkot, a retired military chief. The ultra-Orthodox parties hold enough Knesset seats to determine whether any alternative coalition can reach a majority without Netanyahu's bloc.

title: Liberman says ousting Netanyahu requires enlisting Orthodox parties
